isabel: Heads-up: saw another small window where aggregation totals drifted after an ETL lag spike. This is the fourth recurrence this quarter. We need a different approach: rotate owners, close action items, and add a compact verification step to the pipeline.
omar: yup. Symptoms were: a shard compaction delay -> late spans landed in staging after window closure -> ETL filter removed them -> aggregator reported lower counts.
pager-bot: incident_alert: agg_delta_spike detected at 2025-02-20T07:12:10Z severity=info delta_pct=1.8
nina: Can we do a quick owners reassign and a small playbook? Proposal: 1) immediate hotfix to ensure late spans route to "overflow" stream (owner=omar), 2) a 4-hour prioritized backfill for top-affected metrics (owner=ryan), 3) assign weekly owner to watch reconciliation for 6 weeks (owner=nina).
ryan: I can take the backfill. Plan is to run a prioritized recompute for product_kpis top-50 keys first, idempotent upserts to aggregator_canonical, tag with reconciled_by='remediation-2025-02-20'.
isabel: timeline suggestion: HOT (0-2h): overflow routing hotfix (omar). SAMPLE (2-5h): ryan runs sampler + posts deltas. BACKFILL (5-18h): ryan runs prioritized backfill. MEDIUM (24-72h): merge permanent fixes + CI tests (nina). LONG (1-2w): weekly reconciliation ownership rotation and postmortem closure.
omar: hotfix note: will add a small guard in the ingest path to coalesce missing trace_id -> generated id and mark rows with metadata "ingest_mitigated=true". Feature flag so we can toggle. PR in ~40m.
nina: I'll draft the reconciliation checklist: - run sampler SQL daily for first 6 weeks - if delta_pct > 0.5% sustained 30m, page oncall - keep annotated audit log of reconciled windows - weekly summary to product.
ryan: Sampler SQL I'm using (posting snippet): ```sql
SELECT metric_key, window_start, sum(raw_count) as raw, sum(coalesce(agg_count,0)) as agg, (sum(raw_count)-sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) as delta
FROM reconciliation_view
WHERE ingestion_time >= now() - interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY metric_key, window_start
HAVING abs(sum(raw_count)-sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) > 5
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
isabel: owners: omar=hotfix+merge, ryan=sample+backfill, nina=reconciliation+CI+postmortem, isabel=postmortem owner+product comms. I'll update the postmortem doc and assign due dates.
omar: small caveat: overflow tagging will increase cardinality for some dashboards. I'll run a quick sample once PR is up and post expected cardinality delta.
ryan: backfill proto (idempotent upsert): ```sql
INSERT INTO aggregator_canonical (metric_key, window_start, metric_value, reconciled_by)
SELECT metric_key, window_start, computed_value, 'remediation-2025-02-20'
FROM recompute_from_raw
WHERE <window IN prioritized_list>
ON CONFLICT (metric_key, window_start) DO UPDATE SET metric_value = EXCLUDED.metric_value, reconciled_by = EXCLUDED.reconciled_by;
```
nina: CI additions I'll push: synthetic test that injects late spans and malformed trace_ids, asserts no NaNs and reconciliation_delta_rate < 0.3% on a small slice. Also a periodic smoke that compares aggregator vs raw counts.
isabel: closing conditions to mark postmortem closed: - overflow hotfix deployed and verified in prod, - backfill completed for top-50 keys and validated, - weekly reconciliation running without alerts for 4 consecutive weeks, - postmortem doc updated with owners and dates.
pager-bot: deploy_event: hotfix/overflow-guard opened at 2025-02-20T07:40:22Z by omar
omar: PR opened and running unit tests. tagging @ryan for backfill coordination.
ryan: will wait for hotfix to merge then run sampling and start backfill. ETA to start backfill 3.5h from now.
nina: I'll prepare postmortem update template and a short product-facing summary for expected deltas.
isabel: Great. One extra: let's rotate the weekly reconciliation owner each sprint so ownership doesn't get stale. Adding that as an action item.
omar: PR merged to staging at 2025-02-20T08:05:10Z. Will request a quick prod deploy after canary.
isabel: Thanks team. Next check-in in 6 hours or sooner if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
